local_adaptation: Transport all extracted activity mass using 1-cosine cost; equal activity weights are our choice.
decision: Challenger; no independent company-fit advantage established.
title: Balanced activity optimal transport
mechanism: Every accepted activity receives uniform mass. Pairwise cost is 1 − activity cosine; exact Earth Mover's Distance is solved with both marginals conserved. Activity mass may split across counterparts; this is not one-to-one assignment. Ranking uses negative transport cost. All activities must be accounted for, even weakly matching ones.

title: Equal-page MPNet
mechanism: All retained pages are encoded separately. Each page's mean chunk vector is normalized before page vectors are averaged with equal weights.
